payload.artist_html: N. R. Longrich, X. Pereda-Suberbiola, N. Bardet & N-E Jalil
payload.credit_html: "A new small duckbilled dinosaur (Hadrosauridae: Lambeosaurinae) from Morocco and dinosaur diversity in the late Maastrichtian of North Africa"
payload.description_html: Map showing localities that produced the fossil specimens described in this paper. (A), location of the Oulad Abdoun Basin, central Morocco; (B), localities of hadrosaurids recovered from Sidi Daoui, Mrah Lahrach, and Sidi Chennane. The Sidi Chennane locality produced Minqaria bata and Ajnabia odysseus.
